editorial:
Imagine coming home to find your mom looking like a mummy with bandages all over her face. That is exactly what happens to these twin brothers. They notice right away that she is acting strange, cold, and almost like a different person. You will feel the tension grow as the boys try to figure out if this woman is actually their mother or a fake impostor who took her place. The whole vibe is creepy and makes you question everything you see on screen.

The acting is great because the kids really sell the fear and confusion. You will love how the mystery builds up, though some parts move a bit slow. If you like movies that mess with your head, you should definitely check this out. It is a solid pick for a rainy night when you want something that keeps you guessing.
endingExplained: The big twist reveals that the boys have been struggling with a dark secret. It turns out they actually caused the accident that hurt their mother. The scary parts of the movie were mostly in their heads because they felt so guilty. In the end, you realize the woman was their real mom all along, and the boys were just unable to handle the truth about what they did to her.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves psychological puzzles and creepy family stories.
